reuse.why: The change shares category selection and average actions, but introduces FIXED_TAG instead of using the existing shared tag helpers.

duplication.why: Income eligibility remains repeated in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, and forEachBulkCategory, while FIXED_TAG duplicates existing tag recognition.

placement.why: Budget selection and execution belong in actions.ts and registration follows app.ts conventions, but tag recognition belongs in shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested month-wide actions, their registration, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared selection improves ownership, but fragmented income eligibility, separate tag semantics, and an inaccurate query result type leave avoidable maintenance risks.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts defines FIXED_TAG instead of using shared/tags.ts, and copyPreviousMonth and setZero retain income eligibility outside forEachBulkCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_TAG reshapes the tag-recognition logic already provided by extractTagsFromText and makeTagAqlRegex into a separate budget-specific regular expression.

abstraction_drift.where: The includeHiddenCategories flag propagates through the shared helpers and adds conditional hidden filtering, while copyPreviousMonth and setZero bypass forEachBulkCategory and independently enforce income eligibility.
